**Dated copy (15 Oct 2026), not refreshed since.** The current board is GET https://councilof.ai/api/gspc, mirrored at https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board and https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-living-board.

## Download and use this snapshot

This page describes the published files in `nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-board`. Treat them as a dated snapshot: use the observation dates and limitations in the files and source notes below. A page edit does not refresh the measurements.

With the Kaggle CLI installed and authenticated:

```bash
kaggle datasets download -d nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-board -p ./dataset --unzip
```

Start by inspecting `board.parquet`. Keep its original bytes and record the Kaggle version before transforming or comparing results.

Published files include:

- `llms.txt`
- `README.md`
- `board.csv`
- `eval.yaml`
- `board.json`
- `board.jsonl`
- `board.parquet`
- `manifest.jsonl`
- See the Data tab for all 659 files.

## GSPC board — historical export

This is the older board export mirrored on 15 October 2026. Use its own data and observation dates when reproducing a historical result. It is distinct from the maintained [GSPC Living Board dataset](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/nicktempleman/csoai-gspc-living-board).

Inspect `board.csv`, the axis register and the accompanying README to understand the exported fields and limitations. Use the current board API for a current claim; do not mix a historical row with a newer board total. The complete dated methodology and evidence examples remain in the downloaded `README.md` and the pinned source below.

[Complete source README at the mirrored revision](https://huggingface.co/datasets/csoai/gspc-board/blob/c99e653e03960156897145a374794db93d0922c7/README.md).
